rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday choice for a person or period with nothing to do, rather than for an unused object.

example.english: It rained all day today, so I was idle at home.
example.traditional: 今日落大雨，我成日困喺屋企冇嘢做。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 wan3 hai2 uk1 kei2 mou5 je5 zou6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose description of an engine running slowly without engaging the gears.

example.english: The car is parked by the roadside, and the engine is still idle.
example.traditional: 部車停喺路邊，個引擎仲喺度空轉。
example.jyutping: bou6 ce1 ting4 hai2 lou6 bin1 go3 jan5 king4 zung6 hai2 dou6 hung1 zyun3

rows.note: Use this for spending time doing nothing, including simply idling in an online channel.

example.english: I was idle in the group chat, scrolling on my phone all night.
example.traditional: 我喺個群組入面無所事事，碌咗成晚手機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 go3 kwan4 zou2 jap6 min6 mou4 so2 si6 si6 luk6 zo2 seng4 maan5 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this when idle means habitually unwilling to work or lazy.

example.english: He is not short of time; he is just idle and refuses to do anything.
example.traditional: 佢唔係冇時間，只係懶惰嘅，乜都唔肯做。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 hai6 mou5 si4 gaan1 zi2 hai6 laan5 do6 ge3 mat1 dou1 m4 hang2 zou6

rows.note: Use this when the idle thing is pointless, trivial, or not worth taking seriously.

example.english: This idle argument is pointless and not worth continuing.
example.traditional: 呢啲無謂爭拗，繼續落去都冇意思。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 mou4 wai6 zang1 aau3 gai3 zuk6 lok6 heoi3 dou1 mou5 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this when saying that someone keeps a particular engine running while it idles.

example.english: The driver left the car running idle while we went shopping.
example.traditional: 司機開住架車空轉，等我哋買完嘢返嚟。
example.jyutping: si1 gei1 hoi1 zyu6 gaa3 ce1 hung1 zyun3 dang2 ngo5 dei6 maai5 jyun4 je5 faan1 lai4
